name: Wireless Sensing HAR (WiFi + UWB)
summary: Human-activity release with WiFi CSI across three rooms and a separate UWB CIR branch. The website mini sample uses the WiFi branch and covers every Room 2 activity label.

hardware.platform: WiFi CSI and commercial UWB sensing systems

settings.scenario: Rooms 1 and 3 are continuous participant recordings; Room 2 provides per-activity WiFi clips; UWB is a separate branch

standardization.notes: The WiFi adapter reshapes the released named columns from [T,90] to [T,30,1,3], preserving all native subcarriers and receive links. The compact sample does not imply paired UWB data.
